boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented recurring University of Evansville traditions and campus celebrations.

cards.title: International Bazaar
cards.subtitle: A longstanding fall tradition at University of Evansville
cards.notes: Watch the International Club’s campus showcase of music, dance, crafts, and cultural dress; confirm the current program before attending.
cards.short_summary: A fall campus celebration of the cultures represented at UE.
cards.evidence_claim: UE identifies the International Bazaar, organized by its International Club, as a longstanding fall tradition featuring music, dance, crafts, and a fashion show.
cards.access_notes: Recurring fall event; consult UE’s current event information for date and access.

cards.title: Winter on Walnut
cards.subtitle: UE’s annual holiday celebration
cards.notes: Look for Student Activities Board programming, holiday activities, and the campus-tree lighting; verify this year’s schedule before making plans.
cards.short_summary: An annual winter gathering that includes the campus Christmas-tree lighting.
cards.evidence_claim: UE describes Winter on Walnut as its annual holiday celebration, planned by the Student Activities Board, with ice skating, treats, and campus Christmas-tree lighting.
cards.access_notes: Annual event; confirm current date, location, and activity availability with UE.

cards.title: Purple Palooza
cards.subtitle: UE’s end-of-year celebration
cards.notes: Check the Student Activities Board’s current listing for its end-of-year campus sendoff, including scheduled attractions and performances.
cards.short_summary: A Student Activities Board-coordinated celebration closing the academic year.
cards.evidence_claim: UE describes Purple Palooza as its end-of-year celebration, coordinated by the Student Activities Board, with attractions, rides, musical acts, and food trucks.
cards.access_notes: End-of-year event; consult UE for current date, location, and participation details.

cards.title: UE Bike Race
cards.subtitle: Annual campus bicycle race
cards.notes: Attend as a spectator or join an eligible team through the Fitness Center; follow current race guidance and event rules.
cards.short_summary: An annual team bicycle race around the heart of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: UE calls the UE Bike Race an annual tradition in which student teams compete in a bicycle race around the heart of campus, planned by the Fitness Center.
cards.access_notes: Annual event; participation and spectator details are set in current UE announcements.

cards.title: UE Holi Celebration
cards.subtitle: A newer spring tradition at UE
cards.notes: Join the university’s spring color celebration when offered, and check the current event listing for location and participation guidance.
cards.short_summary: UE’s newer campus observance of the Hindi festival of color.
cards.evidence_claim: UE describes Holi as a new tradition at the university, celebrating spring, love, and unity through colorful powders and music.
cards.access_notes: Event scheduling and participation details vary; verify the current UE listing.

cards.title: International Food Festival
cards.subtitle: Spring event in The Eatery
cards.notes: Watch for the spring event in The Eatery, where UE pairs global cuisines with live music and giveaways.
cards.short_summary: A spring campus food-and-music celebration held in The Eatery.
cards.evidence_claim: UE states that its International Food Festival is held each spring in The Eatery and includes global cuisines, live music, and giveaways.
cards.access_notes: Held in spring; check UE’s current event information for date and any dining requirements.

cards.title: Homecoming and Family Weekend
cards.subtitle: Annual UE alumni, family, and athletics gathering
cards.notes: Use the official weekend schedule to choose a campus activity, alumni gathering, or Purple Aces-related event that fits your visit.
cards.short_summary: UE’s annual weekend connecting students, families, alumni, and athletics.
cards.evidence_claim: UE describes Homecoming and Family Weekend as an annual celebration with athletic events, alumni gatherings, and a Student Activities Board Homecoming Block Party.
cards.access_notes: Annual event; review UE’s current Homecoming and Family Weekend schedule.

cards.title: UE Chili Bowl Sale
cards.subtitle: Clay Club’s annual Empty Bowls philanthropy
cards.notes: Visit the annual sale to see handcrafted bowls made by the UE community and support the event’s local hunger-relief purpose.
cards.short_summary: A long-running UE art-and-philanthropy event supporting hunger relief.
cards.evidence_claim: UE calls the Chili Bowl Sale a longstanding tradition and philanthropy in which the Clay Club, Art Department, and Purple Potters sell handcrafted bowls, with most proceeds supporting a food agency.
cards.source_title: 23rd Annual UE Chili Bowl Sale Returns on October 2
cards.access_notes: Annual sale; bowls and food are purchases, so verify current event details before attending.

cards.title: Honors Common Read Experience
cards.subtitle: Annual tradition of UE’s Honors Program
cards.notes: If you are an incoming Honors student, read the selected text for First Year Seminar and attend the associated author event when scheduled.
cards.short_summary: Incoming Honors students read and discuss one shared text, then engage with its author.
cards.evidence_claim: UE calls the Common Read Experience an annual Honors Program tradition: incoming Honors students read a shared text, discuss it in First Year Seminar, and may engage with an invited author.
cards.source_title: Common Read Program — University of Evansville Honors
cards.access_notes: Limited to incoming Honors students as part of the Honors Program’s first-semester experience.

cards.title: Morgan Whitaker Stankey Andiron Lectures
cards.subtitle: Revived UE intellectual-life lecture tradition
cards.notes: Check the College of Arts and Sciences calendar for the next Andiron Lecture and its speaker, venue, and attendance details.
cards.short_summary: A revived lecture tradition supporting UE’s intellectual life.
cards.evidence_claim: UE states that memorial gifts for alumna Morgan Stankey reinvigorated the long-established Andiron Lecture tradition, once significant to the university’s intellectual life.
cards.access_notes: Lecture dates and access are announced by UE; consult the current event listing.
